text:
Maya: AM async — did a quick sweep, fleet idle nodes in us-west1 up ~4% vs baseline. kicked a prewarm for am-lane. Ran `kubectl scale deployment/gpu-provisioner --replicas=6` to test. No errors.
Chris: Nice. Any quota hits in us-west1? I saw a deny earlier.
Maya: saw one 429 from cloud API at 06:12, quota error for `compute.gpuRequests` on acct infra-dev. Infra-bot posted a ticket: #7892.
infra-bot: [Alert] quota_exceeded: compute.gpuRequests in us-west1 for project infra-dev — ticket #7892 created by maya at 7065432140.
Sam: Blocker: CI canary failing to grab spot instances in eu-west2, getting `NOT_FOUND` for instance-profile. Investigating with cloud team.
Leo: For today I'm going to push the patch to autoscaler so warmup respects per-az buffers. Ping me for CR review @Maya.
Maya: ack — will review after lunch. Also want to coordinate prewarm size — can we cap per-AZ prewarm to 3 instead of 5 for lower burst cost?
Chris: +1 to cap to 3 in eu/apac. us-west1 keep 5 for demo traffic ramp.
Sam: FYI I added a quick flag to the prewarm job: `--per-az=3`. I pushed to branch `ops/prewarm-tune`.
Leo: I'll roll it in to canary tomorrow morning and watch latency. If nothing breaks, we can promote.
Maya: TL;DR: did sweep, filed quota ticket, pushed test scale, will review CRs, plan to reduce per-az prewarm in eu/apac. Blocker: Sam debugging spot profile in eu-west2.
Chris: Thanks team. If cloud quota remains blocked, we flip to fallback model routing to smaller GPU instances — recipes are in ops/runbooks/prewarm.md :thumbsup:
